message.name: AgentCAElectionAdviceV01
message.definition: Scope|This message is sent by a CSD to the issuer (or its agent) to provide information about the clients' election instruction, the registration details, the delivery details, etc. In case of an election with underlying resource movements, it also confirms that these have been completed. This message may also be sent in case of an amendment of an election, once the CSD has completed the required resource movements.|Usage|This message can be used for a new election advice or an amended election advice.|If this message is used for a new election advice, the function of the message must be 'new election'.|If this message is used for an amended election advice, the function of the message must be 'option change' and the identification of the previously sent election advice must be present.|This message can include the cash movements and/or securities movements in the case of an election with underlying resource movements. Additionally, this message can include delivery, certification and beneficial owner details.|Note: this information can be also sent separately in the Agent Corporate Action Information advice message.

rules.name: ElectionTypeRule
rules.text: If ElectionType is CHAN, then PreviousAgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification and AgentCAElectionStatusAdviceIdentification are mandatory.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRule
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: CorporateActionIdentificationRule
rules.text: At least one element in the list (IssuerCorporateActionReference, OfficialCorporateActionReference, CorporateActionProcessingIdentifier) must be present. They may all be may be present.

rules.name: SecuritiesAccountIdentificationOrCashAccountIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either SecuritiesAccountIdentification or CashAccountIdentification must be present.

rules.name: SecuritiesAccountIdentificationOrCashAccountIdentificationRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either SecuritiesAccountIdentification or CashAccountIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OptionTypeRule
rules.text: If ElectionDetails/OptionType is present, then OptionType is not allowed in any occurrences of ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/DebitAccountDetails and/or ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/CreditAccountDetails.||If ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/DebitAccountDetails/OptionType is present at least once and/or ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/CreditAccountDetails/OptionType is present at least once then ElectionDetails/CorporateActionOptionType is not allowed.

rules.name: OptionNumberRule
rules.text: If ElectionDetails/OptionNumber is present, then OptionNumber is not allowed in any occurrences of ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/DebitAccountDetails and/or ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/CreditAccountDetails.||If ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/DebitAccountDetails/OptionNumber is present at least once and/or ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/CreditAccountDetails/OptionNumber is present at least once then ElectionDetails/CorporateActionOptionNumber is not allowed.

rules.name: ElectionType2Rule
rules.text: If ElectionAdviceTypeAndLinkages/ElectionType is CHAN, then ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/CreditAccountDetails/OptionNumber, ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/CreditAccountDetails/OptionType, ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/DebitAccountDetails/OptionNumber and ElectionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails/DebitAccountDetails/OptionType must be present.
